Someone contacted me on 3rd party social media sites posing as Gamdom Staff, what should I do?

August 10, 2026
Table of contents

Important Security Notice – Stay Safe on Gamdom

Official Deposit Channels

  • Gamdom will never contact you personally on social media asking you to deposit funds to a certain address.

  • All deposits are handled exclusively on our official website via the Wallet Page.

Mobile App Warning

  • Gamdom does not have an official mobile app.

  • Any app you may find (including the one currently on the iOS store) is fake and used by scammers.

  • Gamdom exists only as a website.

Scam & Impersonation Attempts

  • Scammers may impersonate Gamdom and send malicious links. Do not click them.

  • If someone contacts you on Instagram, Discord, Steam, or other platforms asking for:

    • Verification

    • Deposits to a wallet address

    • Sponsorship/partnership deals
      → Block and remove them immediately.

Discord & Steam Safety

  • The moderation team will not handle issues via Discord DMs between members.

  • Gamdom staff or moderators will never add you on Steam.

  • If someone claims to be Gamdom staff, block them right away.

  • If you encounter suspicious activity on Discord, report it directly to Discord’s Trust & Safety team and block the user.

✅ Official Gamdom Channels

  • Official Social Media

    • Main: Gamdom.com (@gamdom) on X

    • Sport X: Gamdom Sport (@gamdomsport) on X

    • Facebook: Gamdom

    • YouTube: Gamdom

    • Discord: Join the Gamdom Discord Server!

    • Instagram: @gamdom, @gamdomsport, @gamdomtr, @gamdomturkiyetr

  • Official Telegram Communities

    • Main Account: Gamdom.com Community

    • Japanese: “Gamdom日本公式テレグラムです”

    • Turkish: Gamdom.com TR Topluluğu

    • Sports: Gamdom.com Sport

  • Official Email Address:

    • support@gamdom.com

When in Doubt

If you are unsure about the legitimacy of any contact, always double-check directly with our support team via live chat on the website or by email at support@gamdom.com.
